arxiv-1803-11052.title: Decaying Indicators of Compromise
arxiv-1803-11052.creator: Andras Iklody Gérard Wagener Alexandre Dulaunoy and Sami Mokaddem, Cynthia Wagner
arxiv-1803-11052.description: Abstract The steady increase in the volume of indicators of compromise (IoC) as well as their volatile nature makes their processing challenging. Once compromised infrastructures are cleaned up, threat actors are moving to on to other target infrastructures or simply changing attack strategies.

arxiv-2105-10578.title: A Knowledge Graph-Enhanced Tensor Factorisation Model for Discovering Drug Targets
arxiv-2105-10578.creator: Cheng Ye, Rowan Swiers, Stephen Bonner and Ian P Barrett
arxiv-2105-10578.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Cheng Ye, Rowan Swiers, Stephen Bonner and Ian P Barrett. The drug discovery and development process is a long and expensive one, costing over 1 billion USD on average per drug and taking 10-15 years. To reduce the high levels of attrition throughout the process, there has been a growing interest in applying machine learning methodologies to various stages of drug discovery and development in the recent decade, especially at the earliest stage – identification of druggable disease genes.

arxiv-2108-11518.title: A Systematic Study of Projection Biases in Weak Lensing Analysis
arxiv-2108-11518.creator: P.R.V. Chintalapati, G. Gutierrez, M.H.L.S. Wang
arxiv-2108-11518.description: Abstract We present a systematic study of projection biases in the weak lensing analysis of the first year of data from the Dark Energy Survey (DES) experiment. In the analysis we used a Λ \Lambda CDM model and three two-point correlation functions.

arxiv-2302-12047.title: Domain Generalisation via Domain Adaptation: An Adversarial Fourier Amplitude Approach
arxiv-2302-12047.creator: Minyoung Kim, Da Li & Timothy M. Hospedales
arxiv-2302-12047.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Minyoung Kim, Da Li & Timothy M. Hospedales. We tackle the domain generalisation (DG) problem by posing it as a domain adaptation (DA) task where we adversarially synthesise the worst-case ‘target’ domain and adapt a model to that worst-case domain, thereby improving the model’s robustness.

arxiv-2308-02808.title: Forward production of prompt neutrinos in the atmosphere and at high-energy colliders
arxiv-2308-02808.creator: Mary Hall Reno
arxiv-2308-02808.description: Abstract The atmospheric neutrino flux at very high energies is dominated by prompt neutrinos, mostly contributed by the decays of charmed hadrons produced in the forward direction by cosmic ray interactions with air nuclei. Theoretical predictions of the prompt atmospheric neutrino flux have large uncertainties mainly related to charm hadron production. Prompt neutrinos can also be studied through high-energy colliders.

arxiv-2309-12488.title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization and the Edge of Stability
arxiv-2309-12488.creator: Philip M. Long, Peter L. Bartlett
arxiv-2309-12488.description: Abstract Recent experiments have shown that, often, when training a neural network with gradient descent (GD) with a step size η \eta , the operator norm of the Hessian of the loss grows until it approximately reaches 2 / η 2/\eta , after which it fluctuates around this value.

arxiv-2403-00741.title: Transchromatic phenomena in the equivariant slice spectral sequence
arxiv-2403-00741.creator: Lennart Meier, XiaoLin Danny Shi, Mingcong Zeng
arxiv-2403-00741.description: Abstract . In this paper, we prove a transchromatic phenomenon for Hill–Hopkins–Ravenel and Lubin–Tate theories. This establishes a direct relationship between the equivariant slice spectral sequences of height- h h and height- ( h / 2 ) (h/2) theories. As applications of this transchromatic phenomenon, we prove periodicity and vanishing line results for these theories. 1. Introduction 1.1.

arxiv-2409-09379.title: Disparate effects of circumgalactic medium angular momentum in IllustrisTNG and SIMBA
arxiv-2409-09379.creator: Kexin Liu, Hong Guo ,, Sen Wang, Dandan Xu, Shengdong Lu, Weiguang Cui, Romeel Davé
arxiv-2409-09379.description: Abstract In this study, we examine the role of the circumgalactic medium (CGM) angular momentum ( j CGM j_{\rm CGM} ) on star formation in galaxies, whose influence is currently not well understood. The analysis utilises central galaxies from two hydrodynamical simulations, SIMBA and IllustrisTNG.

arxiv-2411-04559.creator: Andrew Graham and Rob Rockwood
arxiv-2411-04559.description: Abstract . We construct four-variable p p -adic L L -functions for the spin Galois representation of a Siegel modular form of genus 2 twisted by the Galois representation of a cuspidal modular form as the modular forms vary in Coleman families.

pmc-10575969.title: Unravelling the skills and motivations of Magdalenian artists in the depths of Atxurra Cave (Northern Spain)
pmc-10575969.creator: Diego Garate, Olivia Rivero, Joseba Rios-Garaizar, Mª Ángeles Medina-Alcaide, Martin Arriolabengoa, Iñaki Intxaurbe, Juan F. Ruiz-López, Ana Belén Marín-Arroyo, Juan Rofes, Paula García Bustos, Antonio Torres, Sergio Salazar
pmc-10575969.description: Atxurra cave has a decorated assemblage composed of more than a hundred engraved animal depictions. All of them are located in deep parts of the cave and most of them are hidden in raised areas, away from the main path. The main sector is the “Ledge of the Horses”, located at 330 m from the entrance of the cave.

pmc-10605435.title: Personalized Therapy of Sarcomas
pmc-10605435.creator: Ingrid M E Desar, Christian Rothermundt
pmc-10605435.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The heterogeneity of sarcomas is reflected in this Special Issue entitled “Personalized Therapy of Sarcomas”. The systemic treatment options for gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GISTs) are reviewed by Golčić et al. In a disease that previously had a very poor prognosis due to its insensitivity to cytotoxic therapy, the outcome has improved dramatically following the discovery of driver mutations in cKIT, PDGFR and, to a lesser extent, BRAF, NF1 and SDH.

pmc-11290652.title: Cumulative incidence and risk of infection in patients with rheumatoid arthritis treated with janus kinase inhibitors: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11290652.creator: Konstantinos Ouranos, Diana V. Avila, Evangelia K. Mylona, Athanasios Vassilopoulos, Stephanos Vassilopoulos, Fadi Shehadeh, Eleftherios Mylonakis
pmc-11290652.description: Patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) who receive immunosuppressive medications have a heightened risk of infection. The goal of our study was to calculate the pooled cumulative incidence and risk of infection in patients with RA treated with Janus kinase inhibitors (JAKi).

pmc-11336466.title: I (don't) want to go home. Will young people return to the de-occupied territories of Ukraine?
pmc-11336466.creator: Anastasiia Popova, Natalia Tsybuliak, Hanna Lopatina, Yana Suchikova, Sergii Kovachov, Ihor Bogdanov
pmc-11336466.description: This study focuses on understanding the intentions and perspectives of the youth in Ukraine regarding their return to their native cities post-de-occupation. In the context of sustainable regional development, the research aims to grasp the complexities of the youth's mindset, which is crucial for effective policy-making and strategic planning in the post-occupation period.

pmc-11391564.title: Incorporating Transition Metal Ions into Uranium Oxide Hydrates: The Role of Zn(II) and the Effect of the Addition of Cs(I) Ions
pmc-11391564.creator: Timothy A. Ablott, Kimbal T. Lu, Yingjie Zhang
pmc-11391564.description: The synthesis of two zinc-bearing uranium oxide hydrate (UOH) materials has been achieved, and their crystal structures, obtained via single-crystal X-ray diffraction using synchrotron radiation, and additional structural and spectroscopic properties are reported herein. Although both structures incorporate Zn2+ cations, the two differ significantly.

pmc-11543877.title: Innovative eco-friendly methyl orange removal: Mechanism, kinetic, and thermodynamic study using starch cryogel-integrated mesoporous silica nanoparticles
pmc-11543877.creator: Tarawee Taweekarn, Worawit Wongniramaikul, Wilasinee Sriprom, Wadcharawadee Limsakul, Chanadda Phawachalotorn, Aree Choodum
pmc-11543877.description: This study introduces a novel, eco−friendly composite, uncalcined mesoporous silica nanoparticles incorporated into a starch cryogel (MSNs-Cry), designed for the effective removal of methyl orange (MO) from water. MSNs−Cry integrates uncalcined mesoporous silica nanoparticles (MSNs) within a starch cryogel network, leveraging the high adsorption capacity of MSNs. The composite achieved a maximum adsorption capacity of 18.

pmc-11699541.title: Cortical Laminar Bone Membrane: Transforming Regenerative Approaches in Dentistry
pmc-11699541.creator: Rohida Nehal, Ayush Agrawal, Vinayak Thorat, Sanpreet S Sachdev
pmc-11699541.description: Cortical laminar bone membrane (CLBM) is well known for its extraordinary mechanical properties, biocompatibility, and osteoconductive potential, and thus, it has been revealed as a revolutionary biomaterial in periodontal and alveolar bone regeneration. CLBM offers a superior alternative to traditional barrier membranes used in guided bone regeneration (GBR) and guided tissue regeneration (GTR).

pmc-11935609.title: Association Between Genetically Determined Serum Corin and the Risk of Stroke in Chinese Adults: A Mendelian Randomization Study
pmc-11935609.creator: Yang Liu, Linan Chen, Guozhe Sun, Hao Zhang, Wenqing Geng, Xinwei Li, Qiu Zhang, Yibing Jin, Jialing Yao, Xiangdong Yang, Wenxiu Fan, Jiexiang Jing, Shuyao Wang, Hao Peng
pmc-11935609.description: BackgroundSerum corin has been associated with stroke in observational studies, but the underlying causality is uncertain. This study examined the causal association between corin and stroke through Mendelian randomization study.Methods and ResultsIn the Gusu cohort, serum corin was assayed at baseline, and stroke incidents were prospectively obtained during 10 years of follow‐up.

pmc-12397312.title: Latent profile analysis and influencing factors of cognitive flexibility among Chinese high school students
pmc-12397312.creator: Huapeng Guan, Ruikang Hu, Ziyue Zhang, MengTing Shu, Zhen Wang, Wen Wu
pmc-12397312.description: With the advancement of research in educational psychology, cognitive flexibility (CF), as a pivotal ability that enables individuals to adapt to complex environments and tackle challenges, has garnered increasing attention from scholars. For high school students, there is a lack of research regarding latent profiles of cognitive flexibility and associated risk factors.

pmc-12546868.title: Protocol for assessing antibody-mediated cellular phagocytosis of lymphoma cells by human and murine macrophages in vitro
pmc-12546868.creator: Anna C. Beielstein, Stuart Blakemore, Christian P. Pallasch
pmc-12546868.description: SummaryAntibody-dependent phagocytosis is an important process of cell engulfment and degradation by macrophages that holds therapeutical importance in the context of chemo-immunotherapy in, for example, lymphoma. Here, we present an in vitro protocol for determining the antibody-dependent phagocytosis of lymphoma cells by different types of macrophages under different treatment conditions.

pmc-12554423.title: Comparison of Short‐ and Long‐Term Cardiovascular Disease Risk Assessment Tools in US Young Adults
pmc-12554423.creator: Yiyi Zhang, Mengying Xia, Hui Zhou, Mengnan Zhou, Meng Fang, Kristi Reynolds, Norrina B Allen, Abigail Gauen, Lucia C Petito, Vanessa Xanthakis, Monika Safford, Lisandro D Colantonio, Jamal S Rana, Brandon K Bellows, Andrew E Moran, Jaejin An
pmc-12554423.description: BackgroundIn 2023, the American Heart Association published the Predicting Risk of Cardiovascular Disease Events (PREVENT) equations for estimating atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) risk in adults aged 30 to 79 years. We compared PREVENT's performance with existing US guideline recommended models—Pooled Cohort Equations for 10‐year ASCVD risk and FHS (Framingham Heart Study) equations for 30‐year ASCVD risk—among young adults.

pmc-13189103.title: Acute temperature effects on cilia beating increase coral deoxygenation
pmc-13189103.creator: Cesar O. Pacherres, Max S. Dhillon, Mads Bilbo, Mikkel Hansen, Douglas R. Brumley, Manuel Aranda, Soeren Ahmerkamp, Michael Kühl
pmc-13189103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cilia-induced vortical flows are critical for regulating oxygen (O2) and metabolite exchange across coral-water interfaces. While this active ventilation affects the coral tissue microenvironment, its role in thermal stress remains poorly understood. Using high-speed imaging of cilia beating, particle image velocimetry with O2-sensitive nanoparticles, and a mechanistic transport model, we quantified how ciliary dynamics in the reef-building coral Porites lutea respond to acute warming in darkness.

pmc-13627296.title: Strategic foresight and AI readiness: mediating roles of digital transformation capability and students’ perceptions of institutional agility
pmc-13627296.creator: Bright Asare, Sadri Alija, Yarhands Dissou Arthur, Francis Ohene Boateng
pmc-13627296.description: PurposeThe study aimed to investigate the mediating roles of digital transformation capability and students’ perceptions of institutional agility on the relationship between strategic foresight and AI readiness in higher education.Methodology/design/approachThe study adopted a cross-sectional SEM analysis research design. The study targeted university students with a sample size of 311 students. The target students were selected using a convenience sampling technique.
